display_name: The whole Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 as fact-record rules: unfair practices and the Second Schedule, consumer redress, non-conforming goods, the Commission's investigation powers, the offences, and Part 4, with every delegation to regulations a named refusal
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 30 Sep 2026: ss 1 to 44 and the First, Second (Parts 1 and 2, all 27 paragraphs), Fourth and Fifth Schedules; the Third Schedule is repealed. Inert (no condition or answer of their own) are s 1, 5(1), 5(2), 5(3)(a), 7(3), 7(6), 9(5), 9(13), 10(2), (3), (5), (7), (11), 12(6), 15(5), 18(6), 19(5), 20(3) to (5), 22(3), (5), (11), 32(3), (4), (6), 33(3), (4), (6), 34(3), (4), 41(3) and the Fourth Schedule para 4; NOTES.md section 2 gives each reason. NOT encoded: the other Acts the Act points at (Sale of Goods Act 1979, Supply of Goods Act 1982, Hire-Purchase Act 1969, Unfair Contract Terms Act 1977, Small Claims Tribunals Act 1984, Limitation Act 1959), whose answers are facts in the records; and every regulation or order the Minister may make (ss 6(6), 9(7), 9(10), 9(12), 11, 41(2), 42, 43), none of which is an input: where the Act supplies a default figure it is the law, and where it does not the rule is a named REFUSE. Law stated as at 2026-09-30 (the PDF banner).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the statute. No independent test pass has been run: the assertions were written by the same session that wrote the rules. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation and was not compared with an authoritative text. NOTES.md section 6.

forks.F1: s 6(4)(c): (c) read to apply only when none of annual value, annual rent and monthly rent can be ascertained.
forks.F2: s 17(2)(b): read as a further requirement of the other remedy; the literal text makes s 17(1) self-contradictory.
forks.F3: s 14(3): the 6 months end on the 6-month anniversary of delivery; the day of delivery itself is not in the period.
forks.F4: ss 12, 9(12), 6(9), 14(3): 'N years/months after' uses the library's add months, which clamps to the last day of a shorter month.
forks.F5: s 22(6): a warrant runs to the day before the corresponding date one month later.
forks.F6: ss 32(1) and 33(1): encoded as printed; an officer of an association or partnership does not supply the body's state of mind under s 33(1).
forks.F7: s 12(1): with no knowledge date, the last material event alone governs.
forks.F8: s 12(3)(b): one consumer knowledge date is taken.
forks.F9: s 2(1) 'supplier': the employee or agent limb attaches to a person within (a) to (d) in the course of business.
forks.F10: s 26(2): protection turns on the claim being made before disclosure.
forks.F11: s 19(3)(b): 'on demand' read as vacuous where no demand is made.
forks.F12: Second Schedule para 26: the stray comma after the quotation is an extraction artefact.
forks.F13: s 9(4)(e), (f): no deadline is stated and none is added.

projections.note: DMN 1.3 (camunda flavor) for each of the seven rule modules, produced by `l4 export dmn` run directly, NOT by a pipeline projection leg; not executed on an engine. Blocking findings per module are in the .fidelity.txt files.
BPMN 2.0 for the three regulative duties (ss 9(4)(d), 9(4)(e)/(f), 10(6)(c)), by `l4 export bpmn --rule`; not executed.
